title: FB-037 confine dependency atlas stale cleanup
summary: Fix FR-050 by preventing dependency atlas cleanup from deleting unrelated repository-root artifacts that match stale atlas glob names.
reason: Worker finding W11-003 showed generate_dependency_atlas.clean_outputs used broad root-level glob deletion without an ownership/content check.
behavior_before: Dependency atlas cleanup removed any repository-root file matching broad names such as *python_dependencies.png or *dependency_domains.svg.
behavior_after: Dependency atlas cleanup removes only legacy atlas artifacts that are exact legacy names or carry an atlas-generated marker, leaving unrelated matching root files in place.
manual_validation: validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only for unrelated uncovered files: docs/implementation/dynamic-hdr-preservation/PLAN.md, docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Revert the cleanup ownership checks and focused tooling regression test, then rerun the dependency atlas tooling tests.
